_note: Page URL = folder name (projects/<folder>.html). Edit here, then run: python3 build.py (pages) and python3 tools/make_placeholders.py (missing placeholders). Image files live in assets/projects/<folder>/. Gallery layouts are lists of 'kinds' (see 'kinds' below); each row should add up to 12 columns.

projects.title: Collective Housing 01
projects.summary: A residential block read through volume, light and street.
projects.brief: A residential block that had to be understood before construction: its volume, its relationship with the street and the quality of its homes.
projects.approach: The images are built around a late-afternoon light that makes materials legible, with camera heights chosen to match how people will actually see the building. Interiors are furnished for real use, not for a catalogue.

projects.title: Private House 02
projects.summary: Landscape and interior treated as a single scene.
projects.brief: A private house where landscape and interior had to feel like one scene, with a calm and warm atmosphere.
projects.approach: Framings follow the architect’s intent: long views through glazing, honest materials and soft daylight, with vegetation modelled to match the planned landscape design.

projects.title: Interior Design 03
projects.summary: Materials, furniture and daylight composed room by room.
projects.brief: An interior proposal to validate materials, furniture and lighting with the client before anything was bought or built.
projects.approach: Each room is composed as a short series of views: one wide frame to read the space and closer ones for the finishes that carry the design.

projects.title: Public Building 04
projects.summary: Stills and a walkthrough for a larger civic scale.
projects.brief: A larger building presented through stills and a walkthrough, focused on orientation, circulation and the image it projects in its context.
projects.approach: The walkthrough follows the visitor’s route, from approach to entrance to the key interior spaces, with calm camera moves and a Full HD delivery.

projects.title: Renovation 05
projects.summary: A home renovation visualized before the first day on site.

projects.title: Retail Space 06
projects.summary: A retail space with its own identity and carefully chosen materials.

projects.title: Facade 07
projects.summary: A facade photo-integrated into its real urban context.

projects.title: Kitchen 08
projects.summary: Kitchen and living area with natural light.

projects.title: Landscape 09
projects.summary: An outdoor space and its planting at dusk.

projects.title: Walkthrough 10
projects.summary: An animated walkthrough of a building in Full HD.
